It is not selected by mtime, largest wall-clock timestamp or whichever copied ledger opens first. New binding admission must compare-and-swap that head and revalidate before and after construction/admission.

Serialize stop/derive/activate/start; do not release the global admission fence before native/SDK/SQLite drain and actual child exit. required_contract.ownership_manifest: For every known copy/target and payload file, declare branch, logical store/family, canonical root, physical identity and current cleanup owner. Inherited descriptors are observations, not authority for the new branch to write any historical location automatically. Unknown versions/roots or ambiguous ownership block serving before any store opens.
required_contract.historical_targets: Do not edit descriptors under their old hashed IDs or delete target history. A relocated store gets a new legitimate target/step and explicit derivation edge; original branch target history and all known-copy obligations remain durably inventoried. Runtime drivers receive owned current targets or explicit delegated cleanup authority, not implicit cross-branch capabilities.

Retention is not permission to keep revoked payload indefinitely: explicit current-authority cleanup may mutate a declared retained managed copy with real receipts. If bytes are required sealed/immutable, its S copy remains known/pending/non-serving until allowed cleanup; never claim aggregate physical completion. Old claim/version/cursor/COMPLETE is not evidence for a new runtime lease; actual current native return is required. Current Graph getter/aliases/roots must still match sealed bindings.
required_contract.compatibility: Exact source/behavior difference, code ABI and all store schema/API/security invariants must be declared and positively tested. DDL equality alone cannot make an older producer-startup gap compatible. Incompatible code rejects before mutation, but that negative gate is not delivery.
required_contract.publication: Publish a complete code+state binding through one atomic control pointer after all staging/preflight evidence succeeds. Multi-store preparation happens non-serving; no cross-SQL/files/SDK crash atomicity is claimed. Partial derived copies stay tracked and non-serving, never disappear from inventory as a fake cleanup.
